thread:
Leah (CS): Heads up — KnowledgeFlow (onboarding) reporting auth errors to their private VPC for embedding requests since ~08:12 PST. Blocking embed progress for their initial batch. Raising here for status and a comms plan.
Omar (SRE): Seeing elevated 401s and token-refresh failures from auth-vpc service around 08:10. Investigating root cause (token rotation edge-case). Rolling a hotfix branch now; will patch within ~35m.
Maya (AE): They're a priority — 60 seats onboarding, renewal in ~3 months. Any ETA matters for renewal conversation.
Sanjay (Support): Created internal ticket INC-4721 and asked the customer for a failing request-id and sample header. Also requested their onboarding timeline to triage priority.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-4721 created. Severity: P2. Notifying on-call.
Omar (SRE): Quick update — pushed a token-handling patch to auth-vpc canary at 08:43. Canary logs show reduced 401s but still a small number of 503s from embedding workers; looks like downstream retry flood. Planning to enable a temporary fallback routing for affected account IDs to hosted embeddings while we stabilize. ETA for fallback 20m.
Leah (CS): Can we get a short template to send to the customer offering the fallback + expected timeline? Need to avoid scaring them about renewals but be transparent. Drafted copy below — please edit: 
> Hi KnowledgeFlow team — we're sorry for the interruption. We've identified an auth issue affecting private VPC embedding requests and are enabling a temporary fallback to our hosted embeddings for your onboarding batch to restore throughput while we complete a fix. No data will be moved outside your control plane; embeddings will be processed by Redwood-hosted pool only for this window. We'll notify you when your private path is restored (target within 2 hours). We will also apply a goodwill credit for the impacted quota. Would you like us to proceed?
Maya (AE): That reads well. Suggest adding: "If you prefer, we can pause the onboarding batch instead of using fallback." Also propose we offer a 2k credit and a 1:1 onboarding session.
Sanjay (Support): I can send that note once fallback route is live. Please include the exact account IDs I'm allowed to touch.
Omar (SRE): Fallback routing enabled at 09:05 PST for account IDs: KF-2314, KF-2315 (routing tag applied). Observability shows error rate drop from ~22% to <1% within 5 minutes. Still monitoring for KV cache warmup.
Leah (CS): Sending message to customer now and offering the fallback + credits + onboarding session. Message sent at 09:12 PST.
Leah (CS): (message body sent to customer) — "Hi KnowledgeFlow — we've implemented a temporary fallback to restore your embeddings. You should see operations resume now; we'll follow up with an RCA and make sure onboarding completes smoothly. Apologies for the disruption. — Leah (Redwood)"
KnowledgeFlow Rep: Thanks — we see embedding ops resuming in our pipeline. Appreciate the offer of credits, please proceed with the fallback and keep us posted on RCA.
Omar (SRE): Monitoring indicates successful throughput; CPU on hosted pool scaled as expected. We'll continue to investigate root cause in auth rotation logic and prepare a postmortem focusing on token lifetime edge and retry throttling.
Leah (CS): Account health: impacted but stabilized. CS action items: (1) schedule a 1:1 enablement session after RCA, (2) apply offered credits, (3) confirm onboarding completion within 48h. Marking renewal at-risk until we complete enablement call (noting high-touch).
Hannah (RevOps): Noted — I'll tag KF-2314/2315 in the renewal risk dashboard and include this incident in the weekly churn watch.
Sanjay (Support): Customer follow-up scheduled for 09:45 PST to confirm all batches completed. I'll collect any residual logs and escalate if errors reappear.
Omar (SRE): RCA in-progress; will post draft by EOD and include recommended mitigations (stricter token rotation testing, fallback routing docs, and circuit-breaker on retry floods).
Leah (CS): Thanks team. Once RCA is published we'll send a more detailed technical brief to KnowledgeFlow and set the onboarding 1:1. Closing internal bridge once RCA shared.
Leah (CS): Post-note — please add any other items here.
notes: Draft message and fallback offer, credit + enablement session, renewal-risk update to RevOps
